novel_features.name: Top Boards by Saves
novel_features.description: Rank all your boards by total saves across all their pins.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining boards with pin analytics snapshots in SQLite â€” no single API call returns this aggregate.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when you need to know which boards drive the most engagement before planning content.

novel_features.name: Pin Performance Trends
novel_features.description: Track how your pin impressions and saves change week-over-week.
novel_features.rationale: Requires time-series analytics snapshots stored in SQLite across multiple sync runs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to identify content timing patterns and seasonal peaks for your account.

novel_features.name: Stale Boards Detector
novel_features.description: List boards that haven't received a new pin in the last N days.
novel_features.rationale: Requires time-windowed query on last-pin-created timestamp â€” only possible with local SQLite.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for content calendar planning to find gaps before a content audit.

novel_features.name: Ad vs Organic Comparison
novel_features.description: Compare paid campaign performance against organic pin performance side-by-side.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining ad analytics and organic pin analytics â€” no API returns both in one response.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when deciding whether to boost organic pins or increase ad spend.

novel_features.name: Best Posting Time
novel_features.description: Surface which days of the week historically generate the most saves for your account.
novel_features.rationale: Requires aggregating engagement by day-of-week from stored analytics snapshots.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before scheduling new pins to maximize reach based on your own historical data.

novel_features.name: Board Gap Analysis
novel_features.description: Find trending Pinterest topics you haven't covered in your boards recently.
novel_features.rationale: Requires comparing trending API results against local board/pin topic index â€” two data streams no existing tool joins.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when planning content strategy to identify high-opportunity trending topics you're missing.

narrative.headline: Every Pinterest board, pin, and ad â€” plus offline analytics no other tool can answer in a single command.
narrative.value_prop: pinterest-pp-cli wraps the full Pinterest API v5 with a local SQLite data layer that makes compound queries possible. Ask which boards drive the most saves, which days generate peak engagement, or where your ad spend outperforms organic â€” without writing a single API call.
narrative.auth_narrative: Pinterest uses OAuth2. Run 'auth login' to open a browser window for consent. Your access token and refresh token are stored locally and refreshed automatically.

quickstart.comment: Sync boards, pins, and analytics to local SQLite

troubleshoots.fix: Run 'pinterest-pp-cli auth login' to refresh your OAuth token
Pinterest trial access limits to 1000 req/day per category. Wait or apply for standard access.
Run 'pinterest-pp-cli sync' first to populate the local store

narrative.when_to_use: Use pinterest-pp-cli when managing Pinterest boards/pins for a brand, pulling ad performance data, or analyzing which content drives the most engagement. Ideal for agents that need to audit content strategy, compare ad vs organic performance, or find gaps in a content calendar.
anti_triggers: downloading Pinterest images from random URLs without auth
scraping public boards without an API key
